name: Extra Spell Synthesis (Mythic)
body:
You are a master at fusing different magic traditions.

Prerequisite(s): Extra Spell Synthesis, mythic tier 3rd.

Benefit(s): You add ½ your mythic tier to the number of times per day you can use spell synthesis. This stacks with the uses of spell synthesis per day gained through the nonmythic version of this feat.

Special: Unlike the non-mythic Extra Spell Synthesis, this feat may be selected only once.
